scope: ViewNewTorsoMesh chain, part 1: the organized ViewNew/QuadVolume.h kept only one of LevelBuilder's three 2008 buildFace member templates and had lost the static offset() helper. Restored the donor declarations. Part of the repair that took ViewNewTorsoMesh from cl exit 2 (C2244 + C2780) / 0 exact to 55 exact / 11687 B.

blocker.symptom: rebuild/2008-06/native-headers/ViewNew/QuadVolumeFace.h(98): error C2244: 'RBX::ViewNew::LevelBuilder::buildFace' : unable to match function definition to an existing declaration; rebuild/2008-06/native-classes/ViewNewTorsoMesh.cpp(129): error C2780: 'buildFace(Function, G3D::Vector2int16, LevelBuilder::Purpose)' : expects 3 arguments - 4 provided (the TorsoBuilder::buildBottom body calls buildFace<NORM_Y_NEG>(*this, 1, 1, purpose))
blocker.cause: the recovered QuadVolume.h declares only the grid template (template<NormalId id, class Function> buildFace(Function, Vector2int16, Purpose)) while QuadVolumeFace.h defines the strip template body too, and the TorsoMesh unit calls the 4-argument Builder overload. QuadVolumeFace.h's own banner says it holds 'the bodies of the two buildFace templates that QuadVolume.h declares' - the organized header declared only one.

change: declared the strip grid: template<NormalId id, class Function> void buildFace(Function, G3D::Rect2D, const float, G3D::Vector2, G3D::Vector2, const int, G3D::Vector2int16); - matches the QuadVolumeFace.h definition (lines 43..98) and fixes C2244

declared the Builder-by-value overload: template<NormalId id, class Builder> void buildFace(Builder, const unsigned, const unsigned, Purpose); - fixes C2780 for buildFace<NORM_Y_NEG>(*this, 1, 1, purpose)
declared static float offset(RenderSurfaceType surfaceType); - QuadVolumeFace.h line 135 calls offset(surfaceType) (fixed the follow-on C3861)
fix.evidence: donor tools/rbxgs/Client/RbxView/QuadVolume.h lines 70-80 declares exactly these three member templates plus static float offset(RenderSurfaceType); the TorsoMesh call text is verbatim the donor TorsoMesh.cpp line 64 (tools/rbxgs/Client/RbxView/TorsoMesh.cpp); QuadVolumeFace.h defines the strip body it can only reach through the first declaration
